QuestInfo.name: Myra's Old Friend
QuestInfo.0: #p703# in #m010006150# seems to have another request.
QuestInfo.1: #p703# in #m010006150# asked me to tell her old friend, #b#p313##k, what had happened in the Forgotten Hollow. I should be able to find #p313# atop #m10002000#, in the #m10002003#.
QuestInfo.2: When I gave the branch to #p313# in #m10002000#, he was shaken to learn that #p703# is still alive deep in the #m10006000#, and deeply troubled by the rot clinging to it.

0.0: Human... I must ask this of you... The World Tree is in danger... It must be tied to why my friends have changed...
0.1: Long ago... there was a dear friend who lived here with me... His name is #b#p313##k... He left this place with many of the other fairies...
0.2: There is something I must entrust to him... Will you grant me this request?

yes.0: Please take this #b#t4031029##k to him... Long ago, the fairies who left here settled in #m10002000#... Go there, and find him...

1.0: Ah, you're back from the Hollow. Did you find any... Wait. Did you just say #p703#?! She's alive? And what is that... that #b#t4031029##k you carry? Good heavens, the vile energy radiating from it is giving me a headache. Tell me everything, right now!
1.1: But this rot you describe... It is exactly what the Sages feared. That foul energy creeping through the roots of the World Tree. It's the whole reason that stubborn swordsman, Manji, refuses to leave the wasteland. He's been watching for it.
1.2: When the corruption first began, the air itself turned toxic. Many of us had no choice but to flee the #m10006000# and settle up here in #m10002000#.
1.3: If the cursed energy within this #t4031029# is any indication, the rot is accelerating. This is a very serious matter...
1.4: Ahem. Never mind an old man's rambling. I need time to examine this object properly. Go on, shoo! Come back later when I've gathered my thoughts.

npc.0: You still haven't met #p313#...? He is my old friend... Take the #t4031029# to him.

item.0: What brings you here? You say you have something to show me? And yet... where is this thing you claim to carry?

lost.0: Have you lost the #t4031029#...? This time, keep it safe...
